'''Xeshen Kra''' was a [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] involved with the production of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (26 ABY)|Battle of Yag'Dhul]], he helped expose a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] infiltrator on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].
